profiles.description:
zkdesk is building a confidential operating layer for businesses and funds on Robinhood Chain. It brings collateralized credit, treasury management, and payment workflows into one private workspace.

Businesses can use supported tokenized assets as collateral, manage treasury capital through role based permissions, and run bounded payroll, invoice, and vendor payment mandates. Zero knowledge proofs are designed to verify solvency, policy compliance, and payment receipts without publishing every balance, position, rate, or counterparty.

The result is business finance that remains confidential while the protocol rules and selected disclosures stay verifiable.
